name: raiview
description: AI-powered code reviews with Ollama, OpenAI, and Claude

raiview.defaultProvider.description: Default LLM provider to use for code reviews.

raiview.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL for the Ollama instance.

raiview.defaultSystemPrompt.description: Default system prompt sent with every review request. Leave empty to use no system prompt.

enumDescriptions: Full response shown after generation completes

raiview.enhancedReviewer.description: Use the enhanced code-reviewer Modelfile when reviewing with Ollama.

raiview.autoUnloadModel.description: Automatically unload the Ollama model from memory (VRAM/RAM) when starting a new session. Frees memory immediately but adds reload time at the start of the next review. When disabled, a manual 'Free Memory' button is shown before a session starts.

raiview.maxContentChars.description: Maximum characters of file/diff content sent to the LLM per review. Default 10000 chars ≈ 3300 tokens, fits within a 8192 context window alongside the system prompt and response. Increase if your GPU has more VRAM and your model supports a larger context window.

enumDescriptions: 2048 tokens — minimal VRAM usage, very small models or low memory
4096 tokens — recommended for 6 GB VRAM with 7B models
8192 tokens — suitable for 12–16 GB VRAM with 7–13B models
16384 tokens — requires 24+ GB VRAM or CPU offloading
32768 tokens — large models only, 32+ GB VRAM
raiview.ollamaContextWindow.description: Context window size (num_ctx) used when creating the enhanced code-reviewer model in Ollama. Applies on next model creation — delete and recreate the reviewer model after changing this.

raiview.ollamaNumPredict.description: Maximum tokens Ollama generates per response (num_predict). Increase for longer/more detailed reviews; decrease to save VRAM and speed up responses. For the enhanced reviewer model, delete and recreate it after changing this value.
